from scipy.optimize import minimize_scalar
one=np.ones_like(P)
tot=np.sum((dP_dt-dP_dt.mean())**2)
def nmse(cols):
    X=np.column_stack(cols)
    c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dP_dt,rcond=None)
    return np.sum((X@c-dP_dt)**2)/tot, c
g=lambda k: nmse([one,P,P**2,P**2/(1+k*P)])[0]
r=minimize_scalar(g,bounds=(0.01,1),method='bounded',options={'xatol':1e-10})
k=r.x
e,c=nmse([one,P,P**2,P**2/(1+k*P)])
print('k',k,'nmse',e,'coef',c)
print('P3/(1+kP) model', nmse([one,P,P**2,P**3/(1+k*P)])[0])
print('1/(1+kP) model', nmse([one,P,P**2,1/(1+k*P)])[0], nmse([one,P,1/(1+k*P)])[0])

def equation(t, P, params):
    return params[0] + params[1]*P + params[2]*P**2 + params[3]*P**2/(1+params[4]*P)
